# ArrivalFiller

> Free, open-source Chrome extension that fills the official arrival cards of Thailand (TDAC) and Indonesia (All Indonesia) from answers a traveller gave once. Answers stay in the browser. The traveller checks every field and presses Submit. Independent, and not affiliated with either government.

Official forms: https://tdac.immigration.go.th/ and https://allindonesia.imigrasi.go.id/ are the only official addresses for these cards. Both cards are free.

## Any country

- [Arrival card form not working? Start here](https://arrivalfiller.vercel.app/arrival-card-problems): Most arrival card failures come down to one of five things: the wrong website, a date outside the three-day window, a character the field rejects, a session that timed out, or an email that went to spam. Check them in that order. If the form still fails, you can usually finish at the airport: Thailand has kiosks at five airports, and its embassy says the card can be completed until you reach immigration.

## Thailand

- [Thailand Digital Arrival Card (TDAC) guide](https://arrivalfiller.vercel.app/thailand): The TDAC is Thailand's free online arrival card. Non-Thai nationals entering by air, land or sea have needed one since 1 May 2025. File it at tdac.immigration.go.th up to 72 hours before you arrive. It takes four steps, and you get a QR code by email to show at immigration. It isn't a visa, and you need a new one for every entry.
- [TDAC not working: what each error message means](https://arrivalfiller.vercel.app/thailand/tdac-not-working): The TDAC site has four general error messages. "We couldn't verify your request" means wait and retry. "Your session has timed out" means start again. "The system is busy" means the server is struggling, so try later. If nothing works, you can still finish at the airport: the embassy says the TDAC can be completed until you reach immigration, and five airports have kiosks.
- [TDAC date error: why you can't select your arrival date](https://arrivalfiller.vercel.app/thailand/tdac-date-error): The TDAC calendar only offers today and the next three days, counted from the date the site's server sends. If your arrival is further away, the date can't be selected and no setting changes that. Come back once it's inside the window. If you're arriving today, you can still file.
- [TDAC rejects my name, passport or phone: the exact rules](https://arrivalfiller.vercel.app/thailand/tdac-name-passport-phone-errors): TDAC fields accept narrow sets of characters. First and middle names take English letters and spaces only, and family names add one exception: a lone dash. So an apostrophe or hyphen fails. Passport numbers take letters and digits with no spaces, and phone numbers take digits only. Type names the way the machine-readable lines at the bottom of your passport print them, without the punctuation.
- [TDAC accommodation or address step stuck: how it works](https://arrivalfiller.vercel.app/thailand/tdac-accommodation-address-error): The address boxes open in order: accommodation type, then province, then district, then sub-district. Each one stays locked until the one before it has a value picked from its list, and typing without picking doesn't count. The address box takes English characters only, up to 215 characters and five lines, so an address in Thai will fail. If you won't stay in Thailand, tick the transit box instead.
- [TDAC confirmation email not received: what to do](https://arrivalfiller.vercel.app/thailand/tdac-email-not-received): Check your spam folder first, and look for a typo in the address you entered. The email is only a second copy: the submitted page also offers a download, so save that if it's still open. If you have neither at the airport, the Royal Thai Embassy says to tell the immigration officer at the checkpoint.
- [Made a mistake on your TDAC? How to change it after submitting](https://arrivalfiller.vercel.app/thailand/tdac-change-after-submit): You can update a submitted TDAC through the site's update option, using your TH Digital Arrival Card number. You can't update your full name in passport or other locked identity details: the site says to make a new submission instead. A changed flight or a changed hotel generally goes through update, provided your arrival date is inside the three-day window.
- [Fake TDAC websites: how to spot one, and what to do if you paid](https://arrivalfiller.vercel.app/thailand/tdac-fake-websites): The official TDAC is free and lives at tdac.immigration.go.th. Any other address, or any request for a card payment to submit the form, means you aren't on the official site. If you paid one, you may not have a valid card: file again on the official site, ask your bank about the charge, and watch out for messages using the details you gave them.

## Indonesia

- [All Indonesia Arrival Card guide](https://arrivalfiller.vercel.app/indonesia): The All Indonesia Arrival Card is a free online form that combines immigration, customs and health declarations. Everyone arriving needs their own, children and infants included. File it at allindonesia.imigrasi.go.id within 72 hours before you land. You get a QR code by email, which you show with your passport. It isn't a visa, and you don't need an account: there's a guest option.
- [All Indonesia arrival card not working: causes and fixes](https://arrivalfiller.vercel.app/indonesia/all-indonesia-not-working): If the form rejects you with a clear message, it's usually the passport type, an expired passport or a blank required field. If it fails with a technical message, such as an authentication error, the fault is on the server: your entries aren't the cause, so try again later rather than changing them. Allow time before your flight, as the government says it doesn't guarantee uninterrupted access.
- [All Indonesia QR code not received: how to get it back](https://arrivalfiller.vercel.app/indonesia/all-indonesia-qr-code-not-received): Check your spam folder, then use the official site's retrieve option. The site says travellers "may look up and re-download proof of their submission", so a missing email isn't the end. Enter your details exactly as you submitted them. Once you have the code, save it to your phone and take a screenshot, in case you land without data.
- [Mistake on your All Indonesia card? How to update it](https://arrivalfiller.vercel.app/indonesia/all-indonesia-update-after-submit): The site says "you can update the submitted information prior to the trip", and goes further: "You must immediately update your information if there is a change." So a changed flight or hotel, or a wrong detail, should be fixed through the update option before you travel. If that isn't possible, a new submission is the fallback, and you should use the latest QR code.
- [All Indonesia card for families, kids and groups](https://arrivalfiller.vercel.app/indonesia/all-indonesia-family-group): Every traveller needs their own card, including children and infants. The site also has a group option, capped at 10 travellers, and each member's visa has to be confirmed. Families with young children should allow extra time on arrival: a September 2025 report said children under seven can't use the automatic gates, so the whole family queues for manual processing.
- [Fake All Indonesia websites: spot one, and what to do if paid](https://arrivalfiller.vercel.app/indonesia/all-indonesia-fake-websites): The arrival card is free, at allindonesia.imigrasi.go.id. Australia's Smartraveller warns of fake websites charging a fee, and says official sites include "go.id" in the address. If you paid for the card elsewhere, assume you may not hold a valid one: check by retrieving it on the official site, file there if not, and contact your bank.

## Questions about ArrivalFiller

- What does ArrivalFiller do? It's a free Chrome extension for the official arrival cards of Indonesia and Thailand. Fill a card once as usual and it remembers that traveller's answers. Next trip, press Fill on each page, check everything, and submit yourself.
- Is it an official government service? No. It's an independent tool, not affiliated with either government. It fills the official form on the official website, and you remain responsible for what you declare.
- Does it submit the card for me? No. It never presses Next, Continue, Agree or Submit. You check each answer and press those yourself.
- Where do my passport details go? Nowhere. The extension stores them only in your browser's extension storage. It has no account, no server and no analytics, and uninstalling it deletes everything.
- Can it fix an error on the government's site? No. If the site is down or rejects a request, only the government can fix that. It does save you retyping when you have to start again.
- Does it cost anything? No, and the arrival cards themselves are free too. Be careful of websites that charge a fee to submit them.
